newsitem.title: USA: Horizon Mental names Lefton president.
newsitem.headline: Horizon Mental names Lefton president.

text.p: Horizon Mental Health Management Inc said on Thursday it promoted Robert Lefton to president and chief operating officer.
The company said in a news release that Ken Newman, while relinquishing the president title, will remain chairman and chief executive.
Lefton most recently served as executive vice president and co-chief operating officer.
Horizon said it expects to change its name to Horizon Health Corp next month after shareholder approval of its Specialty Healthcare Management Inc acquisition.
Horizon is a contract manager of clinical care programs at general, acute-care hospitals.
